welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to JMF Hosting!
welcome.description: Welcome to the official JMF Hosting Discord server! We provide high-performance, reliable game server hosting with 24/7 support.

fields.name: 📌 About Us
fields.value: JMF Hosting is dedicated to providing premium game server hosting solutions with exceptional performance, reliability, and customer support.

fields.name: 🎮 Our Services
fields.value:
• Game Server Hosting
• Web Hosting
• VPS Solutions
• DDoS Protection
• Custom Server Configurations
• 24/7 Technical Support

fields.name: 🔰 Getting Started
fields.value:
1. Read the <#rules>
2. Verify yourself in <#verification>
3. Check out our available services
4. Create a ticket in <#create-ticket> if you need assistance

leave.title: 👋 Goodbye!
leave.description: **{user.tag}** has left the server. We hope to see them again soon!

verification.title: ✅ Verification Required
verification.description: Welcome to the server! Please click the button below to verify yourself and gain access to the server.

fields.name: Why verify?
fields.value: Verification helps us maintain a safe and secure environment for all members.

create.title: 🎫 Support Ticket
create.description: Welcome to your support ticket! Please describe your issue and a staff member will assist you shortly.

fields.name: Guidelines
fields.value:
• Be clear and specific about your issue
• Provide any relevant information
• Be patient while waiting for a response

close.title: 🎫 Ticket Closed
close.description: This ticket has been closed. A transcript will be saved for reference.

footer.text: Keep chatting to earn more XP!

shop.title: 🛍️ Server Shop
shop.description: Welcome to the shop! Use `!buy <item>` to purchase an item.

footer.text: If this issue persists, please contact support
